Re-pinned 2026-08-24. This target was adjudicated on 2026-08-21 and the pin was voided by edits the store received in the three days after the promotion ran. Second installed skill root: this tree is a byte-identical mirror of the .claude copy -- verified on 2026-08-24 by comparing both trees file by file across all 41 governed skills, which matched on 40 and differed only where this copy was BEHIND. The store-only residue of this artifact was measured line by line against the repository and against 814cc61a, the single commit ever promoted. Everything the repository genuinely lacked was harvested into it first (b9866f4, 72809e8 and fa59749). What remains store-only is one of two things, neither worth keeping: a line the repository deliberately changed after 814cc61a -- including five winding doctrines this repo refuted with measurement on 2026-08-23/24 -- or a machine path the privacy gate rejects and promotion regenerates from placeholders. The drift has a known and now-fixed cause: a Stop hook written 2026-06-28 told every qualifying session to edit the promotion target directly, and was never updated when the pack took governance on 2026-07-24. The repository is the source of record; the transaction backs this copy up before replacing it.
